title: A misclassified covariate that is both balanced and a modifier
question: When a binary effect modifier is misclassified in the source, the target or both, which corrections does population adjustment need, and is correcting the outcome model alone enough?
design: Anchored transport with a misclassified binary modifier under four assay scenarios and two modification strengths; naive, prevalence-corrected and latent-weight MAIC; naive, outcome-only corrected and fully corrected latent-class STC. 8 cells, 1000 replicates each.
